_help: Each file points at Google Drive. Share the file as 'Anyone with the link', then paste its file ID in driveId. status: 'live' shows download buttons; 'soon' shows a placeholder.
note: Files are hosted on Google Drive. Large files may show a virus-scan notice first; choose Download anyway.

items.title: Automated FlatCalibration Panel
items.summary: A motorised telescope cover with a built-in LED flat panel for the Celestron C9.25, controlled from N.I.N.A. Close the cover for darks, light the panel for flats, and let the sequence do the rest.
items.details: Derived from the DarkSkyGeek ASCOM Telescope Cover V2 by Julien Lecomte, reworked with a PWM-dimmed COB LED strip instead of an electroluminescent panel. The package will include the build guide, parts list, 3D-print files and firmware.
